title: Several nodes run _process

title: Path reachability is checked every frame
heuristic_rationale: A configured feature is a measurement candidate, not proof that it is currently visible, costly or unnecessary. Numeric review thresholds are Render Lens heuristics, not Godot limits.
evidence: Text scan of unconditional top-level statements in _process, _physics_process and _integrate_forces finds is_target_reachable(). Methods match by name. Godot docs: "Do not check beforehand if a target position is reachable every frame. What looks like an innocent check is the equivalent of an expensive path query behind the scene."
suggestion: Request the path directly and compare its last point with the target, as the page suggests, instead of checking reachability every frame.
tradeoff: None; the path query is needed anyway.
expected_effect: Potentially reduce work for this feature; no frame-time saving is predicted from configuration alone.
verify_step: Capture a visual reference; change one feature and repeat frame timing plus relevant CPU or GPU profiling in the same scene on target hardware.

title: A script calls a deprecated Godot API that does nothing
evidence: Godot prints "Deprecated. Barriers are automatically inserted by RenderingDevice." when a script calls RenderingDevice.barrier() or full_barrier(), or draw_command_insert_label(); Godot also warns that RenderingServer.reflection_probe_set_resolution() is not available in Godot 4, that environment_set_ssr_roughness_quality() no longer does anything (4.6+), and that NavigationServer3D.region_bake_navigation_mesh() and NavigationMeshGenerator.bake() are deprecated. Calls in comments and strings are ignored.
suggestion: Remove the no-op calls; for navigation, parse source geometry and bake with NavigationServer3D.bake_from_source_geometry_data(); set reflection-probe size in the project settings.
tradeoff: None for the no-op calls; the navigation replacement needs code changes.
expected_effect: Godot uses the configuration as written instead of overriding or ignoring it; no performance saving is asserted.
verify_step: audit_project_rendering or scan_scene, then run the game and confirm the warning is gone from the output

title: A draw call passes an argument Godot ignores

suggestion: Drop the width for filled shapes, or draw an outline separately; use a positive width when antialiasing lines.
tradeoff: A positive width draws triangle strips instead of thin lines.
